anti-sperm-antibody.name: Anti-Sperm Antibody (MAR) Result Reader
anti-sperm-antibody.intro: Interpret the mixed antiglobulin reaction (MAR) test by combining the MAR antibody ratio with sperm percentage, using WHO's 50% cutoff to determine normal vs. abnormal levels of anti-sperm antibodies.

assessor-15.name: Vasography Patency Assessor
assessor-15.intro: Assess vas deferens patency segment by segment (vas deferens, seminal vesicle, ejaculatory duct) based on vasography contrast-media opacification, helping diagnose obstructive azoospermia.

baifenbijisuanqi.name: Progressive Motility (PR) Percentage Calculator
baifenbijisuanqi.intro: Calculate the percentage, proportion, and change rate of progressive motility (PR) and other semen-analysis indicators, for converting key metrics on a semen-analysis report.

calc-volume-concentration.name: Total Sperm Count (Concentration x Volume) Calculator
calc-volume-concentration.intro: Compute total sperm count from semen concentration and ejaculate volume, and evaluate the result against WHO 6th-edition semen-analysis reference values.

detector-9.name: Retrograde Ejaculation (Urine Sperm) Detector
detector-9.intro: Compare paired semen and post-ejaculation urine samples (volume, sperm concentration, total count) plus urine pH and fructose tests to detect sperm backflow into the bladder, aiding male-infertility diagnosis.

embryo-grading.name: Embryo Gardner Grader
embryo-grading.intro: Grade blastocysts using the Gardner system: expansion stage (1-6), inner cell mass (ICM) grade A-C, and trophectoderm (TE) grade A-C, with implantation-potential reference for embryo selection in ART.

endometrial-receptivity.name: Endometrial (Thickness and Triple-Line Sign) Receptivity Assessor
endometrial-receptivity.intro: Input endometrial thickness and whether ultrasound shows the triple-line sign to assess endometrial receptivity during the embryo-transfer window, flagging thin or echo-abnormal risks for ART cycle timing.

epididymal-aspiration.name: Epididymal Aspiration (Sperm) Retrieval Rate Estimator
epididymal-aspiration.intro: Estimate recoverable motile-sperm yield from PESA/MESA epididymal aspiration based on aspirate concentration and volume, to judge whether the yield meets ICSI requirements.

icsi-success.name: ICSI (Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection) Success Rate Estimator
icsi-success.intro: Estimate ICSI fertilization efficiency and clinical-pregnancy expectations from lab indicators (retrieved oocytes, mature oocytes, normal-fertilization count) plus female age, for ART-cycle counseling and QA.

ivf-statistics.name: IVF (Fertilization and Implantation Rate) Statistician
ivf-statistics.intro: Compute fertilization rate, cleavage rate, good-quality embryo rate, implantation rate, and pregnancy rate from oocyte-retrieval to clinical-pregnancy counts, for IVF-cycle outcome statistics and lab QA.

jingzidnasuipian-dfi-zhishu.name: Sperm DNA Fragmentation (DFI) Index
jingzidnasuipian-dfi-zhishu.intro: Input DFI and HDS percentages to assess sperm DNA integrity and its clinical significance in male fertility evaluation.

liquefaction-time.name: Semen Liquefaction Time Judge
liquefaction-time.intro: Judge semen liquefaction status: normal liquefaction is usually completed within 15-30 minutes; failure to liquefy by 60 minutes is abnormal.

pgt-indication.name: PGT (Preimplantation Genetic Testing) Indication Assessor
pgt-indication.intro: Evaluate indications item by item to assess suitability for PGT-A, PGT-M, or PGT-SR, supporting reproductive-genetics screening decisions in ART.

progressive-motility.name: Progressive Motility (PR) Percentage Assessor
progressive-motility.intro: Compute PR, NP, IM percentages and total motility (PR+NP), compared with WHO 5th-edition lower references (PR >= 32%, total motility >= 40%).

rater-30.name: Testicular Biopsy (Spermatogenic Cell) Rater
rater-30.intro: Apply the Johnsen scoring method to rate individual seminiferous tubules from 1 to 10 and compute the mean Johnsen score (MJS) to evaluate spermatogenic function for male-infertility diagnosis.

rater-31.name: Embryo Gardner Score Grader
rater-31.intro: Blastocyst grading with Gardner's system: expansion stage (1-6), inner cell mass (ICM) A-C, and trophectoderm (TE) A-C, with automatic grade assignment and transfer-priority recommendation.

reproductive-hormones.name: Reproductive Hormones (FSH/LH/E2/T) and Spermatogenesis Assessor
reproductive-hormones.intro: Input male FSH, LH, E2, testosterone T, PRL and other reproductive-hormone levels, compare against reference ranges to assess HPG-axis function and classify spermatogenic-disorder type (central vs testicular), for male-infertility initial screening.

retrograde-ejaculation.name: Retrograde Ejaculation (Urine Sperm) Detector
retrograde-ejaculation.intro: Input post-ejaculation centrifuged urine sperm count and semen volume to assess retrograde-ejaculation severity (mild / moderate / severe), comparing with normal semen volume for follow-up in andrology.

semen-volume.name: Semen Volume Assessor
semen-volume.intro: Input ejaculate volume, compare with WHO 5th-edition lower reference 1.5 mL, and prompt possible causes of volume abnormality.

sperm-concentration.name: Sperm Concentration (WHO 5th Edition) Reference
sperm-concentration.intro: Convert Neubauer chamber count results to sperm concentration (x10^6/mL) from counted squares and dilution factor, then compare against WHO 5th-edition 15x10^6/mL cutoff.

sperm-cryopreservation.name: Cryopreserved Sperm (Recovery Rate) Estimator
sperm-cryopreservation.intro: Compute post-thaw recovery rate and motile-sperm recovery rate from pre-freeze and post-thaw total and motile sperm counts, to assess cryopreservation outcome in ART labs.

sperm-dfi.name: Sperm DNA Fragmentation (DFI) Index Assessor
sperm-dfi.intro: Assess sperm DNA integrity using SCSA/SCD assays, with common cutoffs DFI 15% and 25%.

sperm-morphology.name: Sperm Morphology (Strict Criteria) Classifier
sperm-morphology.intro: Under WHO 5th-edition strict morphology criteria, compute the normal-morphology percentage from normal count vs total sperm count, and evaluate fertility risk against the 4% cutoff.

stats-6.name: IVF (Fertilization / Implantation Rate) Statistics
stats-6.intro: Compute fertilization and implantation rates from retrieval, fertilization, and transfer counts, summarizing trends per cycle for preliminary IVF-outcome tracking.

testicular-biopsy.name: Testicular Biopsy (Spermatogenic Cell) Rater
testicular-biopsy.intro: Johnsen scoring (1-10) and modified Silber grading of testicular biopsies to evaluate spermatogenic function and sperm-retrieval prognosis.

testicular-volume.name: Testicular Volume (Prader) Measurer
testicular-volume.intro: Two calculation methods: direct Prader-orchiometer volume input, or ellipsoid formula using length, width, height. Reports left and right testicular volumes with adult reference ~15-25 mL.

total-sperm-count.name: Total Sperm Count (Concentration x Volume) Calculator
total-sperm-count.intro: Compute total sperm count from sperm concentration and ejaculate volume, compare with reference values to flag oligozoospermia for self-check on semen analysis.

vasography.name: Vasography (Patency) Assessor
vasography.intro: Based on contrast-media opacification of vas deferens, seminal vesicle, and ejaculatory duct on vasography, assess patency and hint at likely obstruction sites (testicular end, inguinal segment, pelvic segment) for obstructive azoospermia diagnosis.
